A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TCEC study and contain readable main texts and Appendices A–K. Their equations, tables and figures can be matched despite substantial reformatting.

before.justification: v3 reports original TCEC image and video evaluations, latency measurements, and appendix ablations and comparisons.

after.justification: v4 retains these original empirical results in the main text and appendices.

M1.justification: The DDIM two-step correction, regularized channel-wise coefficient estimation, offline calibration and Appendix D solver adaptation are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both retain COCO and WebVid calibration, MJHQ and sDCI image evaluation, VBench video evaluation, and the CIFAR-10 comparison in Appendix J. No task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: The comparator sets in Tables 1, 2 and 9 and the qualitative figures match. In particular, the QNCD comparison in Appendix J was already present in v3.

E3.justification: Bitwidths, samplers, inference steps, resolutions, metrics and sample counts remain unchanged, including 5K image-evaluation prompts and 50,000 generated samples for the CIFAR-10 comparison.

E4.justification: The accumulation-window, regularization, inference-step and calibration-size studies in Appendices C, F, G and I are unchanged, as are the error analyses in Appendices A and E.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, statistical error bars or significance tests. Uncertainty reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Numerical entries in Tables 1–9 and qualitative examples are unchanged. For example, both report SDXL W4A4 sDCI PSNR of 20.7 for SVDQuant and 21.9 with TCEC in Table 1.

T1.justification: Equations 1–45, the approximation assumptions, the m=1 argument in Appendix B and the DPM++ derivation in Appendix D are retained. Differences concern typesetting rather than mathematical substance.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about closed-form cumulative-error modeling, compatibility with existing PTQ methods, improved generation quality and minimal latency overhead.

C2.justification: Explanations of error accumulation, output correlation, calibration-domain robustness and weaker gains with very few inference steps remain unchanged. No substantive scientific limitation is added or removed.

D1.justification: Both retain the same quantization ranks and group size, coefficient-calibration procedure, regularization rule and hardware information. No implementation or code/data access information is added or removed.

R1.justification: The same 37 cited works and research positioning are retained, including the distinctions from TAC and QNCD. Numbered citations and expanded author names are bibliographic presentation changes.

P1.justification: v4 updates author/contribution/contact details, switches to numbered citations, adds an Appendix heading and removes the brief Impact Statement. Scientific prose and section order remain essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: The two-column main text becomes a single-column ByteDance-branded document, with redesigned title/abstract styling, colored headings, changed typography and captions, and extensive figure/table repositioning. The same four scientific figures and nine tables remain.

improvement.justification: v4 preserves the same scientific argument, empirical evidence, reproducibility details and limitations. Both versions remain readable; the extensive template redesign, updated front matter and removal of the generic Impact Statement do not materially strengthen or weaken the paper.
